_comment: The print helper's download site, apart from the app's own hosting in the repo root so neither deploy can touch the other: a deploy from here replaces only this site, and the app's deploys never drop the download. `dart run tool/build.dart` fills build/site; deploy from this folder with `firebase deploy --only hosting --project multitenant-pos-b8326`. Served as downloads.uzapay.co.ke, a CNAME to uzapay-downloads.web.app.

headers._comment: The CDN keeps it and a browser asks again every time. `no-cache` was tried first and the CDN fetched all 7 MB from the origin on every download, at 14-34 KB/s from Kenya; Hosting clears its CDN on each deploy, so `s-maxage` never serves a superseded helper.
